messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Your dose needs may change if you switch to a different brand, strength, or form of this medicine. Avoid medication errors by using only the medicine your doctor prescribes.
If you use an injection pen, use only the injection pen that comes with insulin glargine. Attach a new needle before each use. Do not transfer the insulin from the pen into a syringe.
Never share an injection pen, even if you changed the needle. Sharing these devices can pass infections from person to person.
Blood sugar can be affected by stress, illness, surgery, exercise, alcohol use, or skipping meals.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia) can make you feel very hungry, dizzy, irritable, or shaky. To quickly treat hypoglycemia, eat or drink hard candy, crackers, raisins, fruit juice, or non-diet soda. Your doctor may prescribe glucagon injections in case of severe hypoglycemia.
Tell your doctor if you have frequent symptoms of high blood sugar (hyperglycemia), such as increased thirst or urination. Ask your doctor before changing your medication dosage.

The relation 'has factor affecting blood sugar' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject medicine's blood sugar levels can be influenced by the factor specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:

B. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'has inconsistent association with': Studies have shown a variable or unconfirmed link between the subject drug and the condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'increases risk of': Taking the subject drug may raise the patient's likelihood of experiencing the condition or event specified by the object entity.
